context: November 5 gave continuous positive momentum in all three indices. Buyers may be coming in with good quantity, but on a flat to gap-up open their confidence stays intact, so they will not run and cannot be targeted.
plan: FLAT TO GAP UP -> BUY, WITH THE MARKET: the buyers cannot be targeted while their confidence holds; identify buying-side setups.
GAP DOWN -> NO PLAN: in a market this positive a sudden gap down may turn sideways or volatile.
